alignments.note: Verb with subject pronoun and auxiliary (rule 17).
Dative לְ before the bare indirect object *thee* (rule 40).
Suffix takes the pronoun (rule 18).
Article takes the written *the*.
Noun.
Waw takes *and* (rule 14).

One verb meaning *divide into three*; the whole *divide … into three parts* is its rendering, discontinuous under rule 25. Head on the lexical verb rather than on the supplied complement, since *divide* is not a light verb (rule 44).
Object marker with no English of its own (rule 16).
Construct noun with a supplied *the* (rule 29: no article morpheme in the phrase).
Rectum takes the chain's *of* (rule 19); discontinuous around the possessive.
Suffix as possessive.
Relative.
Hiphil rendered as causative with a second verb; head on the complement verb (rule 44).
Object suffix.
Divine name.
Construct noun.
Suffix as possessive.
The ASV writes no connective for the waw of וְהָיָה.

The ASV writes no presentative frame for הָיָה at all — no *it shall come to pass* stands in the verse — so nothing realizes this verb. Rule 45 gives a הָיָה the complementizer of a frame the ASV has written; with the frame absent, the *that* answers to the לְ of the recast infinitive clause instead. Corrected from the accepted reading, which aligned הָיָה to the bare *that*.

לְ + infinitive construct recast as a finite clause: the preposition takes the complementizer *that* while the infinitive keeps its supplied modal and lexical verb (rule 52, settled in 28 corpus units and never placed on the infinitive). The competing reading gives the *that* to the presentative הָיָה under rule 45.
Infinitive keeps the supplied modal and the lexical verb (rule 52).
Adverb with its directive he fused as *thither* (rules 30, 32), headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme.
כֹּל takes the written *every*.
Participle.

review_notes: Corrected: the single *that* moves from הָיָה to the לְ of לָנוּס. Rule 45's complementizer belongs to a presentative frame the ASV has actually written, and this verse writes none; rule 52's finite recasting of לְ + infinitive (*that … may flee*) is the construction the ASV did write, and it puts the complementizer on the preposition. הָיָה and its waw are both left unrepresented.
*into three parts* is kept inside the unit of שִׁלַּשְׁתָּ, the one verb it renders.
